structured.summary: v108 completed the stalled full in-vivo evaluation of the v104 TSG (Temporal-Structure-Guided scan targeting) mechanism behind --temporal_structure_scan and ran the pre-registered GT-overlap coverage adjudication. The [TSG-GATE] hard gate passed (15 [TSG] lines in the reused v104 smoke log, 69 in the full log; fired 4/64 succeeded videos), so the mechanism genuinely ran live — FM5 refuted. Full metrics: mAP 0.15833597680401443, AP@0.3 0.21233, AP@0.5 0.14905, AP@0.7 0.11364, avg latency 302.99s/video; smoke mAP 0.1443 (reused v104 flag-on smoke, copied with source noted). The pre-registered adjudication found coverage strictly WORSE: selected segments covered 23.50s & 3/5 GT segments vs baseline 38.50s & 5/5 (delta -15.00s, -2 segments), and the nominal-grid sensitivity mapping also showed no improvement (-1.33s, +0). Per the pre-registered rule, the decision is REVERT regardless of the noise-band headline mAP. This was a verify-only loop with no v108 backup dir, so no restore was needed; the mechanism was confirmed default-OFF in config.py, batch_evaluate.py, and run.py (byte-identical baseline behavior, code inert). Artifacts were copied to iteration_logs/results/ (v108_smoke_run.log, v108_smoke_eval.json from v104 smoke; v108_full_run.log, v108_full_eval.json), the report was written to iteration_logs/ideas/loop1_v108_tsg-live-completion-test_20260721.md, and the session_v97_ledger.md row was appended with kept=false.
structured.lessons: FM5 refuted for TSG (gate passed, mechanism fired live 4/64), making this a true negative result; FM1 confirmed — EventVAD-style temporal-gradient+motion peaks in UCF-Crime flat-CLIP categories actively misalign with anomaly location (coverage -15.0s, -2/5 GT segments vs the near-random incumbent). The pre-registered coverage adjudication proved essential: headline mAP alone (0.1583, within the +/-0.03 noise band) would have looked neutrally acceptable and risked keeping a mechanism that misdirects scan budget. Exact segment-time reconstruction (stride 4.5s verified) plus agreement under both grid mappings makes the revert robust to segment-indexing ambiguity.
